log: Cold, slippery, barely food.
Raw and cold. You chew and swallow.
Slippery and bland. Better than nothing.

text: Something in it disagrees with you.

actions.label: cook
log: The fish hisses on a flat stone by the fire.
The fish spits and curls on a hot stone.
Fat drips into the embers. The fish browns.
Hot flesh, flaking from the bone.
Hot and soft. You eat it down to the bones.
It burns your fingers. You eat it anyway.
Salty and chewy. Barely a mouthful.
You suck the meat from the shells. Salt, mostly.
Chewy, salty, gone in a moment.

actions.label: cook
log: The shell pops open in the embers.
The shells hiss and crack open in the heat.
Steam, a snap, and the shells open.
Tender and hot. The smell of the sea.
Hot and tender, tasting of the sea.
Soft meat from hot shells. Better cooked.

name: matches
_note: a box of 10 from the shipwreck; light fire uses one

name: water can
_note: stays when the water is gone; 'fill' at a water source you have explored

actions.label: fill
log: You hold the can in the spring until it brims.
Cold water gurgles into the can.
You fill the can to the top and screw the lid on tight.

name: water in the can

log: You drink from the can. It tastes of tin, but it is water.
A long swallow from the can.
You drink, then screw the lid back on tight.

_note: up to 4 drinks; refilled from the water can's 'fill'

log: Hard biscuit and salt meat, soaked with sea water. Still food.
You chew a ration slowly, making it last.
Salt meat and a damp biscuit. Your stomach is grateful.
